newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech IPB CZK 430 mln Q1 gross profit.
newsitem.headline: Czech IPB CZK 430 mln Q1 gross profit.

text.p: IPB a.s., the third largest Czech bank, said on Wednesday that its first quarter gross profit, calcluated according to Czech accounting standards, rose to 430 million crowns from 397 million in 1996.

IPB officials added at a news conference that the bank's first quarter net profit was 427 million crowns, while interest income was 5.3 billion crowns. Comparative net profit and interest income for the same period last year was not immediately available.
The bank's balance sheet total at the end of the quarter was 235 billion crowns, compared to 213 billion at the end of the first three months of 1996.
Earlier at the news conference, IPB said its 1996 net profit, calculated according to Czech accounting standards, was 857 million crowns, down from 1.13 billion for 1995.
